propositions: The completion-verification gate produces bare LLMError with null diagnostic when agentic verify exhausts step budget in a tool-call loop, wasting 40-70% of affected runs.
The tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 when toolConfig is removed mid-run after toolUse blocks appear in history.
Runaway tool-call cycles must be detected during run execution and aborted early, routing to bounded recovery with fresh per-criterion evidence instead of poison-history verdicts.
Budget exhaustion and runaway detection must leave operator-actionable gate_error_v1 sidecars with repetition counters distinguishing loop from room exhaustion.
Gate runs must durably record request and tool-call usage by default including loop-vs-breadth distinction (distinct_ratio_window) to enable tuning from production data.
